principle: The canonical 14 gates and their order are unchanged. Production mode is an orthogonal run dimension that changes what evidence a gate requires and who owns it, never which gates exist or in what sequence.
unspecified_policy: A run with MODE_UNSPECIFIED gets no mode-conditional answer. Gates whose evidence or ownership varies by mode fail closed rather than assuming one, because guessing PRODUCTION silently commits a human to perform and guessing DRAFT silently accepts a proxy.

capture-checklist.static_owner_note: The single owner recorded in GATE_OWNERS. It is correct for PRODUCTION and wrong for DRAFT, which is why ownership has to become mode-aware.

DRAFT.meaning: Proxy delivery readiness. A draft is performed by the machine, so nothing here may require Mikko to record.
required_evidence: synthetic delivery manifest (proxy presenter delivery plan)
blocked_by: no synthetic delivery artifact contract exists; presenter-take-manifest models real human delivery only (TRANSCRIPT_SOURCES HUMAN_SUPPLIED/IMPORTED/EXTERNAL_TRANSCRIPTION, FIDELITY_METHODS ... HUMAN_VERIFIED, createHumanSelection)
PRESENTER_A_ROLL is excluded from visual-plan-prompt-adapter PROMPT_MEDIA, so presenter delivery is contractually not machine-generable
no text-to-speech, avatar, or synthetic-voice producer exists anywhere in the repository
DRAFT.owner_actionable_reason: generation_supervisor is enabled and proven, but the proxy presenter and synthetic narration it would need do not exist. An enabled owner is not an actionable gate.

REVIEW.meaning: Entering REVIEW introduces no capture requirement. Review judges a draft that already exists; whatever capture the draft produced stands.
REVIEW.note: Gate 7 is not re-opened by a DRAFT -> REVIEW transition. Requiring recapture on mode change would make the lifecycle logically impossible.
REVIEW.owner_actionable_reason: REVIEW does not re-enter capture. The run already carries the capture evidence its DRAFT produced.

PRODUCTION.meaning: Machine preparation for a real recording session, then Mikko's actual performance. The two are separate and only the first is automatable.
blocked_by: presenter_director is contract status PLANNED (build_order 7), NOT_PROVEN, autonomous_dispatch DISABLED
its enablement prerequisites are unmet and include an explicit human enablement decision by Mikko
PRODUCTION.human_owns: the physical performance itself, which no agent may synthesize away
PRODUCTION.owner_actionable_reason: preparation is orchestrable, but presenter_director is contract PLANNED / NOT_PROVEN / DISABLED, so delivery direction cannot be dispatched yet.

DRAFT.meaning: A zero-human draft crosses capture evidence on machine-verifiable proxy media. QC validates the proxy disposition; Mikko is not involved and no human marker may be written.
blocked_by: no producer exists for the proxy presenter or synthetic narration the PROXY_CAPTURE_READY disposition must attest
PRESENTER_A_ROLL is capture-class by design (edit-plan maps it to PRESENTER_CAPTURE, alongside SCREEN_CAPTURE and ARCHIVAL_EXTERNAL), so it is not produced by the generation lane
DRAFT.architecture_need: DRAFT does not end before capture-evidence-review. It needs a PROXY_CAPTURE_READY evidence class attested by a real synthetic-delivery producer. Until that producer exists the gate is honestly BLOCKED; it must never be crossed by writing a human marker or by relabelling proxy media as real capture.
DRAFT.previously_required_human_approval: Before this decision the gate required a human marker in every mode, which made zero-human DRAFT impossible. The requirement is now PRODUCTION-only.

REVIEW.meaning: Already settled by the DRAFT that produced the draft. Entering REVIEW does not re-earn it.

PRODUCTION.meaning: Mikko confirms the real captured material. Proxy capture recorded during DRAFT remains historical evidence and can never stand in for a human performance.
PRODUCTION.human_owns: confirmation that the captured material is what was intended

capture-evidence.human_gate_today_note: The static HUMAN_GATE annotation is true for PRODUCTION and false for DRAFT. Human authority at this gate is mode-dependent.

dispositions.PROXY_CAPTURE_REQUIRED: gate 7, DRAFT: a machine-generated presenter/narration substitute must be produced
dispositions.PROXY_CAPTURE_READY: gate 8, DRAFT: machine-verified proxy media exists and is sufficient to proceed toward rough-cut assembly. Explicitly NOT a human performance.
dispositions.REAL_CAPTURE_REQUIRED: gate 7, PRODUCTION: a real recording session must be prepared and performed
dispositions.REAL_CAPTURE_CONFIRMED: gate 8, PRODUCTION: Mikko has confirmed the real captured material
dispositions.REUSE_PRIOR_CAPTURE: REVIEW: capture is not re-entered; prior evidence stands

review_entry.rule: DRAFT runs through gate 8 on proxy evidence; REVIEW then begins at gate 9. No fifteenth gate, and no recapture triggered by the mode change.

production_promotion.proxy_does_not_carry: DRAFT proxy capture stays historical evidence and does not satisfy PRODUCTION capture policy
production_promotion.regression: if a run promoted to PRODUCTION has only proxy capture, the capture gates are no longer satisfied and the canonical lifecycle reopens them
production_promotion.downstream_preserved: rough-cut and review artifacts are retained as provenance from the approved draft, exactly as gate-6 approval regression preserves downstream work
